name: graph_query
description: Run one read-only Cypher query (Kuzu dialect) against the knowledge graph and get JSON rows back (at most 200 rows). Nodes: Episode(id), Passage(id), Claim(id, signal), Entity(id, name, kind), Thesis(id). Claim.signal is the 0-100 investment-signal score (NULL if not ranked yet; NULLs sort first in ORDER BY DESC, so filter them out). Relationships: (Episode)-[:CONTAINS]->(Passage), (Claim)-[:EVIDENCED_BY]->(Passage), (Claim)-[:ABOUT]->(Entity), (Passage)-[:MENTIONS]->(Entity), (Claim)-[:SUPPORTS {strength}]->(Thesis), (Claim)-[:CHALLENGES {strength}]->(Thesis), (Thesis)-[:ABOUT]->(Entity). Stance edge strength is 0-100 (only strength >=25 is projected). Node ids are the Postgres UUIDs; fetch claim and passage text with postgres_database_query.
